# Publicités NOCTURIA avec WAN

Choisir une branche avant le rendu et sélectionner vos fichiers dans ses Load Image.

- Scène complète : image1 produit, image2 visage, image3 tenue, image4 lieu.
- Produit seul : image1 produit, image2 lieu.

Adapter le produit, son nom, le geste, le format et la durée dans le prompt ET dans les réglages du node. Vérifier le préfixe SaveVideo : celui de la scène sérum est encore nommé Gothic_Powder dans cet export. Le prompt de produit seul contient des restes de texte sur le sérum : le remplacer par l'exemple parfum du manuel.

Les images personnelles ne sont pas incluses dans les JSON. Vérifier les nodes actifs, l'accès API et le coût affiché avant de lancer. Regarder la vidéo avec le son et contrôler les inscriptions, les gestes et les raccords.

Manuel : docs/manuel.md ou docs/manuel.html dans le paquet.

widgets_values:
Create a 15-second cinematic luxury Serum commercial in horizontal
16:9, with three elegant shots.

REFERENCES:
@Image1 defines the exact serum.
@Image2 defines the adult gothic woman's facial identity, long hairstyle
@Image3 defines her outfit and body proportions.
@Image4 defines the location.

Using the NOCTURIA “Moonlight Elixir” serum in @Image1 and
the adult woman in @Image2, create a 15-second photorealistic
luxury skincare commercial in landscape orientation, 16:9.

Preserve the woman's facial identity and natural skin tone.
Dress her in a Wednesday Addams-inspired black gothic outfit
with a white collar. Keep her complexion makeup minimal.

0–5 seconds:
Close-up of the serum bottle and its dropper. Preserve the exact
bottle, materials and inscriptions “NOCTURIA” and “Moonlight Elixir”
from @Image1. The glass pipette is attached to the underside of
the same dropper cap. Show one bottle and one dropper assembly.

5–10 seconds:
Macro shot of the pipette held just above a clean fingertip.
One small drop of serum forms at the tip and falls onto the finger.
The pipette does not touch the skin. Match the serum's appearance
to the reference. Realistic liquid behavior, natural hands,
one droplet and no continuous stream.

10–15 seconds:
Cut to a beauty close-up as she gently presses the serum onto
one cheek with her fingertips. She lowers her hand and turns
slightly toward the light, revealing a subtle fresh sheen.
Preserve freckles, pores and natural skin texture throughout.
No instant wrinkle removal or dramatic complexion transformation.

Refined gothic setting with a candlelit background and soft,
neutral beauty lighting. Delicate glass reflections, restrained
gestures and realistic skincare application.
No extra pipettes, no floating drops, no liquid near the eyes.

Subtle gothic instrumental music, no speech, no subtitles
or added graphic text.

Audio: a perfect gothic music in a manor

widgets_values:
Create a 15-second cinematic luxury perfume commercial in horizontal
16:9, with three elegant shots.

REFERENCES:
@Image1 defines the exact perfume bottle, cap, materials, colors
and label. If it contains several panels, use them as references
for one physical product; do not reproduce the reference sheet.
@Image2 defines the adult elven woman's facial identity, hairstyle
and subtly pointed ears.
@Image3 defines her outfit and body proportions.
@Image4 defines the location.

0–5 seconds:
In the forest pavilion from @Image4, the woman stands beside a pale
stone display pedestal. The closed perfume bottle rests on it.
Filtered sunlight creates soft patterns across the architecture.
Medium shot with a slow camera push-in. She gently turns her head
toward the camera, with a calm, confident expression. Leaves move
slightly in the background.

5–10 seconds:
Cut to a closer beauty shot. She holds the same closed bottle
delicately at upper-chest height, slightly beside her face. The
front label faces the camera, unobstructed by her fingers.
She looks directly into the lens, then gives a restrained smile.
Keep her hands relaxed, the gesture minimal and the bottle steady.

10–15 seconds:
Cut to a hero close-up of the same closed bottle on the pale stone
pedestal. Ferns and the ancient forest remain softly out of focus
behind it. A slow, subtle camera move reveals the bottle's material
and metallic details. Finish with a steady, sharp product shot held
for the final two seconds.

Photorealistic luxury beauty advertising, forest-green, pale stone
and soft silver palette. Natural skin texture, realistic sunlight,
elegant and restrained movement. Preserve the woman's identity,
outfit and the bottle design across all shots. Keep the original
GREENDALE and Queen Forest inscriptions.
One bottle per shot, cap attached throughout. No spraying, no
opening, no additional products, no floating objects, no magical
transformation, no subtitles or added graphic text.

Audio: soft cinematic strings, a few delicate wooden flute notes,
subtle leaves rustling and distant forest birds. No speech, no
singing. End with a gentle musical resolution.

Using the nail polish product in @Image1 and the adult woman in
@Image2, create a 10-second photorealistic luxury beauty commercial in portrait orientation, 9:16.

Preserve the woman's facial identity. Dress her in a Wednesday
Addams-inspired black gothic outfit with a white collar and sleeves that leave her hands clearly visible.

Begin with a close-up of the nail polish bottle beside her hand.
Cut to a macro shot of the brush applying one smooth coat to a single fingernail resting on a black marble surface. The brush is attached to the underside of the bottle cap. Show only one cap and one brush.

Finish with an elegant close-up of her finished manicure beside
the closed bottle. She slowly tilts her hand to reveal the polish's color, shine and reflections. Match the nail color and finish to the product reference. Keep the nails consistent in length and shape, with clean cuticles and anatomically natural fingers.

Preserve the bottle design, materials and original label from
@Image1. Gothic candlelit atmosphere, refined lighting, shallow
depth of field. Subtle gothic instrumental music, no speech,
no subtitles or added text.
